comparison.objective: Hand-mount the final section of a bicycle tire bead without a lever; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-bead redistribution and progressive seating versus rigid tool alignment, rotary adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Bead fully seated without lever use, tube/rim damage or bead escape versus two safe repeatable impacts. Candidate dynamic rejection thresholds are partly undeclared.
comparison.reason: The tire task centers on deformable-object tension management, absent from the rigid damper task.
